//: The preview sidecar's configuration — and the security boundary of this
The sidecar spawns real build commands. Everything that decides WHAT runs
is in this file and nowhere else: a preview request names a *site* from
`sites` below, and can never supply a root, a command, or an argument.
Without that rule, POST /sessions is remote code execution against whoever
`astro` is a built-in engine. In dev mode the sidecar runs `astro dev`,
not a loop of `astro build` — Astro's dev server is Vite, so it already
does fine-grained HMR, which is the 'keep state and scroll position'
behaviour done properly by the framework rather than by DOM morphing.
//allowedOrigins: The CMS editor origins allowed to drive this sidecar. Loopback origins are
always allowed, so a local CMS needs nothing here; add your deployed
editor's origin when previewing against a hosted CMS.
